docs.title: Document Management System
docs.text:
Welcome to the Document Management System (DMS) project documentation.

This documentation defines the product vision, business requirements, functional requirements and functional specifications.

docs.title: Project Overview
docs.text: The Document Management System aims to provide a centralised platform for managing, organising, storing and retrieving digital documents.
